class SourceError < StandardError
  attr_reader :line, :column
  def initialize(line, column, message)
    @line, @column = line, column
    super(message)
  end
end

module Lexer
  TYPES = %w[int float bool string void].freeze
  KEYWORDS = (TYPES + %w[if else while for return break continue true false switch case default]).freeze
  ASSIGNMENT = %w[= += -= *= /= %=].freeze
  TWO = %w[<= >= == != && || += -= *= /= %=].freeze

  def self.scan(lines)
    tokens, comments, sequence = [], [], []
    previous_line = 0
    lines.each_with_index do |line, row|
      pos = 0
      while pos < line.length
        if line[pos] == ' '
          pos += 1
          next
        end
        start = pos
        rest = line[pos..]
        kind = :symbol
        if rest.start_with?('//')
          value, kind, pos = rest.rstrip, :line_comment, line.length
        elsif rest.start_with?('/*')
          stop = line.index('*/', pos + 2)
          raise SourceError.new(row + 1, pos + 1, 'unterminated comment') unless stop
          pos = stop + 2
          value, kind = line[start...pos], :block_comment
        elsif (match = /\A[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9]*/.match(rest))
          value = match[0]
          pos += value.length
          kind = KEYWORDS.include?(value) ? :keyword : :identifier
        elsif (match = /\A[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?/.match(rest))
          value, kind = match[0], :number
          pos += value.length
        elsif line[pos] == '"'
          pos += 1
          pos += line[pos] == '\\' ? 2 : 1 while pos < line.length && line[pos] != '"'
          raise SourceError.new(row + 1, start + 1, 'unterminated string') if pos >= line.length
          pos += 1
          value, kind = line[start...pos], :string
        elsif TWO.include?(line[pos, 2])
          value = line[pos, 2]
          pos += 2
        elsif '+-*/%<>=!()[]{},;.?:'.include?(line[pos])
          value = line[pos]
          pos += 1
        else
          raise SourceError.new(row + 1, pos + 1, "unexpected character '#{line[pos]}'")
        end
        entry = {text: value, kind: kind, line: row + 1, column: start + 1,
                 blank: [0, row - previous_line].max, order: sequence.length}
        previous_line = row + 1
        if %i[line_comment block_comment].include?(kind)
          comments << entry
        else
          entry.merge!(index: tokens.length, leading: [], trailing: [])
          tokens << entry
        end
        sequence << entry
      end
    end
    tokens << {text: '', kind: :end, line: lines.length + 1, column: 1,
               blank: 0, index: tokens.length, leading: [], trailing: [], allowed: true}
    [tokens, comments, sequence]
  end
end

require_relative 'lexer'
require_relative 'parser'
require_relative 'doc_builder'
require_relative 'printer'
require_relative 'report'

class Formatter
  include Docs
  attr_reader :item_docs

  def initialize(profile, tokens)
    @profile, @tokens = profile, tokens
    @indent = profile[:indent]
    @space = profile[:space_around_operators] ? ' ' : ''
    @keyword_space = profile[:space_after_keyword] ? ' ' : ''
    @operator_break = profile[:space_around_operators] ? LINE : SOFTLINE
    @kr = profile[:brace_style] == 'kr'
    @item_docs = []
  end
  def sep(count) = cat(Array.new(1 + [count, @profile[:max_blank_lines]].min, HARDLINE))
  def pre_blank(token) = (token[:leading].first || token)[:blank]
  def comments(sequence, following)
    parts = []
    sequence.each_with_index do |comment, index|
      parts << comment[:text]
      next_entry = sequence[index + 1] || following
      parts << (comment[:own] ? sep(next_entry[:blank]) : ' ') if next_entry
    end
    cat(parts)
  end
  def t(token, leading = token[:leading])
    cat(comments(leading, token), token[:text], trailing(token))
  end
  def trailing(token)
    suffix(token[:trailing].map { |comment| comment[:text] }.join(' ')) unless token[:trailing].empty?
  end
  def split_comments(token)
    last = token[:leading].rindex { |comment| comment[:own] }
    last ? [token[:leading][0..last], token[:leading][last + 1..]] : [[], token[:leading]]
  end
  def closing_comments(own, nonempty)
    return '' if own.empty?
    cat(nonempty ? sep(own.first[:blank]) : nil, comments(own, nil))
  end
  def whole_file(items, ending)
    parts = []
    items.each_with_index do |item, index|
      parts << sep(pre_blank(item[:first])) if index > 0
      document = item(item)
      @item_docs << document
      parts << document
    end
    parts << closing_comments(ending[:leading], !items.empty?)
    cat(parts)
  end
  def item(entry)
    return variable(entry) unless entry[:tag] == :function
    cat(t(entry[:typ]), ' ', t(entry[:name]), list_doc(entry[:parameters]), HARDLINE, block(entry[:body]))
  end
  def parameter(entry)
    cat(t(entry[:typ]), ' ', t(entry[:name]), entry[:brackets].map { |left, right| cat(t(left), t(right)) })
  end
  def variable(entry)
    parts = [t(entry[:typ]), ' ', t(entry[:name])]
    entry[:dimensions].each do |left, value, right|
      parts.concat([t(left), value ? expr(value, 0) : nil, t(right)])
    end
    if entry[:equals]
      parts.concat([@space, t(entry[:equals]), @space, initializer(entry[:initializer])])
    end
    parts << t(entry[:semi]) if entry[:semi]
    cat(parts)
  end
  def initializer(entry) = entry[:tag] == :list ? list_doc(entry) : expr(entry, 0)
  def list_doc(entry)
    left, right = entry.values_at(:left, :right)
    return cat(t(left), t(right)) if entry[:elements].empty?
    force = @tokens[left[:index]...right[:index]].any? { |token| token[:source_trailing] }
    elements = entry[:elements].map do |element|
      if element[:tag] == :parameter
        parameter(element)
      elsif entry[:role] == '{'
        initializer(element)
      else
        expr(element, 0)
      end
    end
    contents = [SOFTLINE, elements.first]
    entry[:commas].zip(elements.drop(1)).each { |comma, element| contents.concat([t(comma), LINE, element]) }
    if entry[:role] == '{'
      contents << if_break(',', '')
      contents << trailing(entry[:trailing]) if entry[:trailing]
    end
    group(cat(force ? BREAK_PARENT : nil, t(left), nest(@indent, cat(contents)), SOFTLINE, t(right)))
  end
  def statement_sequence(statements)
    parts = []
    statements.each_with_index do |stmt, index|
      parts << (index.zero? ? HARDLINE : sep(pre_blank(stmt[:first])))
      parts << statement(stmt)
    end
    cat(parts)
  end
  def block(entry)
    own, inline = split_comments(entry[:right])
    stmts = entry[:statements]
    return cat(t(entry[:left]), t(entry[:right], inline)) if stmts.empty? && own.empty?
    inner = cat(stmts.empty? ? HARDLINE : statement_sequence(stmts), closing_comments(own, !stmts.empty?))
    cat(t(entry[:left]), nest(@indent, inner), HARDLINE, t(entry[:right], inline))
  end
  def body(entry)
    separator = @kr ? ' ' : HARDLINE
    return cat(separator, block(entry)) if entry[:tag] == :block
    if @profile[:add_braces]
      cat(separator, '{', nest(@indent, cat(HARDLINE, statement(entry))), HARDLINE, '}')
    else
      nest(@indent, cat(HARDLINE, statement(entry)))
    end
  end
  def simple(entry)
    return expr(entry[:expr], 0) unless entry[:tag] == :assign
    cat(expr(entry[:left], 0), @space, t(entry[:op]), @space, expr(entry[:right], 0))
  end
  def control_header(entry)
    cat(t(entry[:keyword]), @keyword_space, t(entry[:left]), expr(entry[:test], 0), t(entry[:right]))
  end
  def if_statement(entry)
    parts = [control_header(entry), body(entry[:body])]
    if entry[:else_token]
      join = @kr && (entry[:body][:tag] == :block || @profile[:add_braces]) ? ' ' : HARDLINE
      alternative = entry[:alternative]
      parts.concat([join, t(entry[:else_token]), alternative[:tag] == :if ? cat(' ', if_statement(alternative)) : body(alternative)])
    end
    cat(parts)
  end
  def for_statement(entry)
    contents = []
    initial = entry[:initial]
    contents << (initial[:tag] == :variable ? variable(initial) : simple(initial)) if initial
    contents << t(entry[:first_semi])
    contents.concat([LINE, expr(entry[:condition], 0)]) if entry[:condition]
    contents << t(entry[:second_semi])
    contents.concat([LINE, simple(entry[:update])]) if entry[:update]
    cat(t(entry[:keyword]), @keyword_space, t(entry[:left]), group(align(cat(contents))), t(entry[:right]), body(entry[:body]))
  end
  def clause(entry)
    cat(t(entry[:label]), entry[:value] ? cat(' ', expr(entry[:value], 0)) : nil,
        t(entry[:colon]), entry[:statements].empty? ? nil : nest(@indent, statement_sequence(entry[:statements])))
  end
  def switch_statement(entry)
    own, inline = split_comments(entry[:closing])
    header = cat(control_header(entry), @kr ? ' ' : HARDLINE, t(entry[:opening]))
    clauses = entry[:clauses]
    return cat(header, t(entry[:closing], inline)) if clauses.empty? && own.empty?
    contents = []
    clauses.each_with_index do |part, index|
      contents << (index.zero? ? HARDLINE : sep(pre_blank(part[:first])))
      contents << clause(part)
    end
    contents << HARDLINE if clauses.empty?
    contents << closing_comments(own, !clauses.empty?)
    cat(header, nest(@profile[:indent_case_labels] ? @indent : 0, cat(contents)), HARDLINE, t(entry[:closing], inline))
  end
  def statement(entry)
    case entry[:tag]
    when :block then block(entry)
    when :variable then variable(entry)
    when :simple_stmt then cat(simple(entry[:value]), t(entry[:semi]))
    when :return then cat(t(entry[:keyword]), entry[:expr] ? cat(' ', expr(entry[:expr], 0)) : nil, t(entry[:semi]))
    when :flow then cat(t(entry[:keyword]), t(entry[:semi]))
    when :if then if_statement(entry)
    when :while then cat(control_header(entry), body(entry[:body]))
    when :for then for_statement(entry)
    when :switch then switch_statement(entry)
    end
  end
  def level(entry) = entry.fetch(:level, 8)
  def last_token(entry)
    case entry[:tag]
    when :primary then entry[:value]
    when :paren, :index then entry[:right]
    when :unary then last_token(entry[:operand])
    when :binary then last_token(entry[:right])
    when :conditional then last_token(entry[:no])
    when :call then entry[:arguments][:right]
    when :member then entry[:member]
    end
  end
  def opened(entry, minimum)
    while @profile[:remove_parens] && entry[:tag] == :paren
      inner, left, right = entry.values_at(:inner, :left, :right)
      break if level(inner) < minimum || !left[:leading].empty? || !right[:leading].empty?
      inner[:first][:trailing].unshift(*left[:trailing])
      last_token(inner)[:trailing].concat(right[:trailing])
      left[:trailing] = []
      right[:trailing] = []
      entry = inner
    end
    entry
  end
  def binary(entry)
    precedence, chain, current = level(entry), [], entry
    while current[:tag] == :binary && level(current) == precedence
      chain << [current[:op], current[:right]]
      current = opened(current[:left], precedence)
    end
    contents = chain.reverse.map do |op, operand|
      cat(@operator_break, t(op), @space, expr(operand, precedence + 1))
    end
    group(cat(expr(current, precedence), nest(@indent, cat(contents))))
  end
  def conditional(entry)
    contents, current = [], entry
    loop do
      contents.concat([@operator_break, t(current[:question]), @space, expr(current[:yes], 0),
                       @operator_break, t(current[:colon]), @space])
      following = opened(current[:no], 0)
      unless following[:tag] == :conditional
        contents << expr(following, 0)
        break
      end
      contents << expr(following[:test], 1)
      current = following
    end
    group(cat(expr(entry[:test], 1), nest(@indent, cat(contents))))
  end
  def postfix_piece(entry)
    case entry[:tag]
    when :call then list_doc(entry[:arguments])
    when :index then cat(t(entry[:left]), expr(entry[:index], 0), t(entry[:right]))
    when :member then cat(t(entry[:dot]), t(entry[:member]))
    end
  end
  def postfix(entry)
    operations, current = [], entry
    while %i[call index member].include?(current[:tag])
      operations << current
      current = opened(current[:target], 8)
    end
    operations.reverse!
    segments = [[]]
    operations.each do |operation|
      segments << [] if operation[:tag] == :member
      segments.last << operation
    end
    calls = (1...segments.length).select { |index| segments[index].any? { |part| part[:tag] == :call } }
    head = expr(current, 8)
    return cat(head, operations.map { |op| postfix_piece(op) }) if calls.length < 2
    split = calls.first
    preceding = segments.take(split).flatten.map { |op| postfix_piece(op) }
    following = segments.drop(split).map { |segment| cat(SOFTLINE, segment.map { |op| postfix_piece(op) }) }
    group(cat(head, preceding, nest(@indent, cat(following))))
  end
  def expr(entry, minimum)
    entry = opened(entry, minimum)
    case entry[:tag]
    when :primary then t(entry[:value])
    when :paren then cat(t(entry[:left]), expr(entry[:inner], 0), t(entry[:right]))
    when :unary then cat(t(entry[:op]), expr(entry[:operand], 8))
    when :binary then binary(entry)
    when :conditional then conditional(entry)
    when :call, :index, :member then postfix(entry)
    end
  end
end

def attach_comments(tokens, comments, sequence)
  cursor = 0
  comments.each do |comment|
    cursor += 1 while cursor < tokens.length - 1 && tokens[cursor][:order] < comment[:order]
    previous = cursor > 0 ? tokens[cursor - 1] : nil
    following = tokens[cursor]
    next_entry = sequence[comment[:order] + 1]
    comment[:own] = comment[:kind] == :line_comment || !next_entry || next_entry[:line] > comment[:line]
    if previous && previous[:line] == comment[:line] && (following[:kind] == :end || following[:line] > comment[:line])
      previous[:trailing] << comment
    else
      following[:leading] << comment
    end
  end
  tokens.each { |token| token[:source_trailing] = !token[:trailing].empty? }
end

def render_once(lines, profile)
  tokens, comments, sequence = Lexer.scan(lines)
  attach_comments(tokens, comments, sequence)
  items = Parser.new(tokens).parse
  tokens.each do |token|
    token[:leading].each do |comment|
      if token[:trailing_comma] || (comment[:own] && !token[:allowed])
        raise SourceError.new(comment[:line], comment[:column], 'comment not allowed here')
      end
    end
  end
  return {lines: [], comments: comments, document: nil, function: nil} if items.empty? && tokens.last[:leading].empty?
  builder = Formatter.new(profile, tokens)
  document = builder.whole_file(items, tokens.last)
  formatted = Printer.layout(document, profile)
  index = items.index { |item| item[:tag] == :function }
  {lines: formatted, comments: comments, document: document,
   function: index ? items[index] : nil, function_doc: index ? builder.item_docs[index] : nil}
end

def main
  profiles, profile = {}, nil
  File.foreach('input/style.txt', chomp: true) do |line|
    next if line.empty?
    if line.start_with?('[')
      profile = profiles[line[1...-1]] = {}
    else
      key, value = line.split('=', 2)
      value = value.to_i if %w[width indent max_blank_lines comment_column].include?(key)
      value = value == 'yes' if %w[space_around_operators space_after_keyword indent_case_labels add_braces remove_parens].include?(key)
      profile[key.to_sym] = value
    end
  end
  sources = []
  File.foreach('input/sources.txt', chomp: true) do |line|
    if line.start_with?('=== ')
      _, name, style = line.split(' ')
      sources << {header: line, name: name, profile: profiles[style], lines: []}
    else
      sources.last[:lines] << line
    end
  end
  output = %w[formatted idempotency diagnostics doc_tree changes].to_h { |name| [name, []] }
  sources.each do |source|
    name, profile = source.values_at(:name, :profile)
    original = source[:lines].map(&:rstrip)
    output['formatted'] << source[:header]
    output['doc_tree'] << "=== #{name}"
    output['changes'] << "=== #{name}"
    begin
      first = render_once(source[:lines], profile)
    rescue SourceError => error
      output['formatted'].concat(original)
      output['idempotency'] << "#{name}: skipped (syntax error)"
      output['diagnostics'] << "#{name}:#{error.line}:#{error.column}: error: #{error.message}"
      output['doc_tree'] << 'syntax error'
      output['changes'] << 'skipped (syntax error)'
      next
    end
    formatted = first[:lines]
    output['formatted'].concat(formatted)
    begin
      second = render_once(formatted, profile)[:lines]
      difference = (0...[formatted.length, second.length].min).find { |i| formatted[i] != second[i] }
      status = if formatted == second
                 'stable'
               else
                 "unstable at line #{difference ? difference + 1 : [formatted.length, second.length].min + 1}"
               end
    rescue SourceError => error
      status = "unstable (second pass: #{error.line}:#{error.column}: #{error.message})"
    end
    output['idempotency'] << "#{name}: #{status}"
    formatted.each_with_index do |line, index|
      output['diagnostics'] << "#{name}:#{index + 1}: warning: line too long (#{line.length} > #{profile[:width]})" if line.length > profile[:width]
    end
    groups = Docs.groups(first[:document])
    output['doc_tree'] << "metrics lines=#{formatted.length} longest=#{formatted.map(&:length).max || 0} comments=#{first[:comments].length} groups=#{groups.length} broken=#{groups.count { |g| %i[break forced].include?(g[:mode]) }} forced=#{groups.count { |g| g[:mode] == :forced }}"
    if first[:function]
      output['doc_tree'] << "function #{first[:function][:name][:text]}"
      output['doc_tree'].concat(Report.tree(first[:function_doc]))
    else
      output['doc_tree'] << 'no function'
    end
    output['changes'].concat(Report.diff(original, formatted))
  end
  output['diagnostics'] << 'no diagnostics' if output['diagnostics'].empty?
  output.each { |name, rows| File.write("output/#{name}.txt", rows.map { |line| line.rstrip + "\n" }.join) }
end

require_relative 'lexer'

class Parser
  PRECEDENCE = {'||'=>1, '&&'=>2, '=='=>3, '!='=>3, '<'=>4, '<='=>4,
                '>'=>4, '>='=>4, '+'=>5, '-'=>5, '*'=>6, '/'=>6, '%'=>6}.freeze
  def initialize(tokens)
    @tokens, @cursor = tokens, 0
  end
  def peek = @tokens[@cursor]
  def at?(text) = peek[:text] == text
  def shift
    token = peek
    @cursor += 1
    token
  end
  def fail_expected(expected)
    actual = peek[:kind] == :end ? 'end of file' : "'#{peek[:text]}'"
    raise SourceError.new(peek[:line], peek[:column], "expected #{expected}, found #{actual}")
  end
  def take(text)
    fail_expected("'#{text}'") unless at?(text)
    shift
  end
  def identifier
    fail_expected('identifier') unless peek[:kind] == :identifier
    shift
  end
  def type
    fail_expected('type') unless type?
    shift
  end
  def type? = Lexer::TYPES.include?(peek[:text])
  def node(tag, first, **props) = {tag: tag, first: first, **props}
  def allow(token) = token[:allowed] = true
  def parse
    items = []
    until peek[:kind] == :end
      typ, name = type, identifier
      allow(typ)
      items << if at?('(')
                 params = list('(', ')', false) { parameter }
                 node(:function, typ, typ: typ, name: name, parameters: params, body: block)
               else
                 variable(typ, name, true)
               end
    end
    items
  end
  def parameter
    typ, name, brackets = type, identifier, []
    brackets << [take('['), take(']')] while at?('[')
    node(:parameter, typ, typ: typ, name: name, brackets: brackets)
  end
  def variable(typ, name, semicolon)
    dimensions = []
    while at?('[')
      left = take('[')
      value = at?(']') ? nil : expression
      dimensions << [left, value, take(']')]
    end
    equals = at?('=') ? take('=') : nil
    value = equals ? initializer : nil
    semi = semicolon ? take(';') : nil
    node(:variable, typ, typ: typ, name: name, dimensions: dimensions,
         equals: equals, initializer: value, semi: semi)
  end
  def initializer
    at?('{') ? list('{', '}', true) { initializer } : expression
  end
  def list(opening, closing, trailing)
    left, elements, commas, final = take(opening), [], [], nil
    unless at?(closing)
      element = yield
      allow(element[:first])
      elements << element
      while at?(',')
        comma = take(',')
        if trailing && at?(closing)
          comma[:trailing_comma] = true
          final = comma
          break
        end
        commas << comma
        element = yield
        allow(element[:first])
        elements << element
      end
    end
    node(:list, left, left: left, right: take(closing), elements: elements,
         commas: commas, trailing: final, role: opening)
  end
  def block
    left, statements = take('{'), []
    until at?('}') || peek[:kind] == :end
      stmt = statement
      allow(stmt[:first])
      statements << stmt
    end
    right = take('}')
    allow(right)
    node(:block, left, left: left, right: right, statements: statements)
  end
  def body
    stmt = statement
    allow(stmt[:first]) unless stmt[:tag] == :block
    stmt
  end
  def statement
    return block if at?('{')
    return variable(type, identifier, true) if type?
    return control_if if at?('if')
    return control_while if at?('while')
    return control_for if at?('for')
    return control_switch if at?('switch')
    if at?('return')
      keyword = shift
      value = at?(';') ? nil : expression
      return node(:return, keyword, keyword: keyword, expr: value, semi: take(';'))
    end
    if at?('break') || at?('continue')
      keyword = shift
      return node(:flow, keyword, keyword: keyword, semi: take(';'))
    end
    value = simple
    node(:simple_stmt, value[:first], value: value, semi: take(';'))
  end
  def control_if
    keyword, left = take('if'), take('(')
    test = expression
    right, before = take(')'), body
    else_token = at?('else') ? take('else') : nil
    alternative = if else_token
                    at?('if') ? control_if : body
                  end
    node(:if, keyword, keyword: keyword, left: left, test: test, right: right,
         body: before, else_token: else_token, alternative: alternative)
  end
  def control_while
    keyword, left = take('while'), take('(')
    test = expression
    right = take(')')
    node(:while, keyword, keyword: keyword, left: left, test: test, right: right, body: body)
  end
  def control_for
    keyword, left = take('for'), take('(')
    initial = at?(';') ? nil : (type? ? variable(type, identifier, false) : simple)
    first_semi = take(';')
    condition = at?(';') ? nil : expression
    second_semi = take(';')
    update = at?(')') ? nil : simple
    right = take(')')
    node(:for, keyword, keyword: keyword, left: left, initial: initial,
         first_semi: first_semi, condition: condition, second_semi: second_semi,
         update: update, right: right, body: body)
  end
  def control_switch
    keyword, left = take('switch'), take('(')
    test = expression
    right, opening, clauses = take(')'), take('{'), []
    while at?('case') || at?('default')
      label = shift
      allow(label)
      value = label[:text] == 'case' ? expression : nil
      colon, statements = take(':'), []
      until %w[case default }].include?(peek[:text]) || peek[:kind] == :end
        stmt = statement
        allow(stmt[:first])
        statements << stmt
      end
      clauses << node(:clause, label, label: label, value: value, colon: colon, statements: statements)
    end
    closing = take('}')
    allow(closing)
    node(:switch, keyword, keyword: keyword, left: left, test: test, right: right,
         opening: opening, closing: closing, clauses: clauses)
  end
  def simple
    left = expression
    if Lexer::ASSIGNMENT.include?(peek[:text])
      op = shift
      node(:assign, left[:first], left: left, op: op, right: expression)
    else
      node(:expr_stmt, left[:first], expr: left)
    end
  end
  def expression
    test = binary(1)
    return test unless at?('?')
    question = take('?')
    yes = expression
    colon = take(':')
    node(:conditional, test[:first], test: test, question: question, yes: yes,
         colon: colon, no: expression, level: 0)
  end
  def binary(level)
    return unary if level > 6
    left = binary(level + 1)
    while PRECEDENCE[peek[:text]] == level
      op = shift
      left = node(:binary, left[:first], left: left, op: op, right: binary(level + 1), level: level)
    end
    left
  end
  def unary
    if at?('-') || at?('!')
      op = shift
      return node(:unary, op, op: op, operand: unary, level: 7)
    end
    target = primary
    loop do
      target = if at?('(')
                 node(:call, target[:first], target: target, arguments: list('(', ')', false) { expression })
               elsif at?('[')
                 left = take('[')
                 index = expression
                 node(:index, target[:first], target: target, left: left, index: index, right: take(']'))
               elsif at?('.')
                 node(:member, target[:first], target: target, dot: take('.'), member: identifier)
               else
                 break
               end
    end
    target
  end
  def primary
    if %i[identifier number string].include?(peek[:kind]) || %w[true false].include?(peek[:text])
      token = shift
      return node(:primary, token, value: token)
    end
    if at?('(')
      left = take('(')
      inner = expression
      return node(:paren, left, left: left, inner: inner, right: take(')'))
    end
    fail_expected('expression')
  end
end

require_relative 'doc_builder'

module Printer
  def self.fits?(remaining, first, stack)
    return false if remaining < 0
    check, cursor = [first], stack.length - 1
    loop do
      if check.empty?
        return true if cursor < 0
        check << stack[cursor]
        cursor -= 1
      end
      indent, mode, doc = check.pop
      if doc.is_a?(String)
        remaining -= doc.length
      else
        case doc[:kind]
        when :if_break then remaining -= doc[mode == :break ? :broken : :flat].length
        when :line
          return true if mode == :break
          remaining -= 1
        when :softline then return true if mode == :break
        when :hardline then return true
        when :concat then doc[:parts].reverse_each { |part| check << [indent, mode, part] }
        when :group then check << [indent, doc[:forced] ? :break : mode, doc[:child]]
        when :nest, :align then check << [indent, mode, doc[:child]]
        end
      end
      return false if remaining < 0
    end
  end

  def self.layout(document, profile)
    lines, current, pending = [], +'', []
    width, column = profile[:width], profile[:comment_column]
    finalize = lambda do
      value = current.rstrip
      unless pending.empty?
        comment = pending.join(' ')
        if column > 0 && value.length < column - 1 && column - 1 + comment.length <= width
          value += ' ' * (column - 1 - value.length) + comment
        else
          value += ' ' + comment
        end
      end
      pending.clear
      lines << value
    end
    stack = [[0, :break, document]]
    until stack.empty?
      indent, mode, doc = stack.pop
      if doc.is_a?(String)
        current << doc
        next
      end
      case doc[:kind]
      when :if_break then current << doc[mode == :break ? :broken : :flat]
      when :line, :softline, :hardline
        if doc[:kind] == :hardline || mode == :break
          finalize.call
          current = ' ' * indent
        elsif doc[:kind] == :line
          current << ' '
        end
      when :suffix then pending << doc[:text]
      when :concat then doc[:parts].reverse_each { |part| stack << [indent, mode, part] }
      when :nest then stack << [indent + doc[:amount], mode, doc[:child]]
      when :align then stack << [current.length, mode, doc[:child]]
      when :group
        selected = if mode == :flat
                     :flat
                   elsif doc[:forced]
                     :forced
                   elsif fits?(width - current.length, [indent, :flat, doc[:child]], stack)
                     :flat
                   else
                     :break
                   end
        doc[:mode] = selected
        stack << [indent, selected == :flat ? :flat : :break, doc[:child]]
      end
    end
    finalize.call
    lines
  end
end

module Report
  def self.tree(doc, depth = 0)
    prefix = '  ' * depth
    return [prefix + "text \"#{doc}\""] if doc.is_a?(String)
    case doc[:kind]
    when :concat then doc[:parts].flat_map { |part| tree(part, depth) }
    when :group then [prefix + "group #{doc[:mode]}"] + tree(doc[:child], depth + 1)
    when :nest then [prefix + "nest #{doc[:amount]}"] + tree(doc[:child], depth + 1)
    when :align then [prefix + 'align'] + tree(doc[:child], depth + 1)
    when :suffix then [prefix + "suffix \"#{doc[:text]}\""]
    when :if_break then [prefix + "if_break \"#{doc[:broken]}\" \"#{doc[:flat]}\""]
    else [prefix + doc[:kind].to_s]
    end
  end

  def self.diff(a, b)
    n, m = a.length, b.length
    lcs = Array.new(n + 1) { Array.new(m + 1, 0) }
    (n - 1).downto(0) do |i|
      (m - 1).downto(0) do |j|
        lcs[i][j] = a[i] == b[j] ? lcs[i + 1][j + 1] + 1 : [lcs[i + 1][j], lcs[i][j + 1]].max
      end
    end
    i = j = 0
    hunks, hunk = [], nil
    while i < n || j < m
      if i < n && j < m && a[i] == b[j]
        hunks << hunk if hunk
        hunk = nil
        i += 1
        j += 1
      else
        hunk ||= {i: i, j: j, deleted: 0, inserted: 0, rows: []}
        if j == m || (i < n && lcs[i + 1][j] >= lcs[i][j + 1])
          hunk[:rows] << '-' + a[i]
          hunk[:deleted] += 1
          i += 1
        else
          hunk[:rows] << '+' + b[j]
          hunk[:inserted] += 1
          j += 1
        end
      end
    end
    hunks << hunk if hunk
    rows = ["hunks=#{hunks.length} deleted=#{hunks.sum { |h| h[:deleted] }} inserted=#{hunks.sum { |h| h[:inserted] }}"]
    hunks.each do |h|
      d, e = h.values_at(:deleted, :inserted)
      rows << "@@ -#{h[:i] + (d > 0 ? 1 : 0)},#{d} +#{h[:j] + (e > 0 ? 1 : 0)},#{e} @@"
      rows.concat(h[:rows])
    end
    rows
  end
end
